source: The default scene (852 nm tweezer along x, B = 3 G along z, D2 probe) with a weak D1 beam (0.01 mW/cm2) 2 GHz off, as the app sends it: the validation of v2026.11.3.2 (claude/validate-3d, repro/F2_default_plus_weak_D1_beam.json, finding F2). Near light on both D lines puts the largest frequency gap of the ground couplings between the hyperfine splitting and the D1-D2 spread, so the population core's gap rule kept every F = 1 - F = 2 static coupling below it, foldable or not, and the released 3D solve refused the scene (mixing 2.5e-11).
